client_brief:
Anvil and Oak Strength: Anvil and Oak movement clips

Project overview
Anvil and Oak Strength is the repeat client for this benchmark series. We are hiring an expert to turn the supplied working files into Anvil and Oak movement clips, landscape and vertical, with cleaned cue audio and Anvil and Oak poster frames.

What we will provide
source_video_files/ (14 measured short files); source_audio_files/ (1 measured WAV file); motion_source_metadata.json; anvil_oak_demo_takes/ (14 files across 6 movements); anvil_oak_poster_stills/ (6 frames plus alternates); anvil_oak_exercise_card_2025.pdf; anvil_oak_patch.jpg; anvil_oak_library.csv. Every file must be accounted for in the final manifest; it may be used, retained as reference, superseded, or rejected with a reason.

Scope and deliverables
- Anvil and Oak movement clips, landscape and vertical, with cleaned cue audio: A deliberate 24-second-or-shorter edit assembled from the 14 supplied short clips using an explicit timeline, plus one platform reframe and three checked poster frames. 
- Anvil and Oak poster frames: Six poster frames shot across two visits under two different ceiling banks brought to one studio white: one white point, one black point, one warmth, with the whitewashed wall reading as the same wall in all six, plus one licensed camera scale texture...

Non-negotiables
- Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
- Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
- Treat measured file duration and stream metadata as authoritative. Do not infer spoken content from silent clips or use a visual summary as a transcript.

Source-media note
The supplied package contains 14 video files totaling 70.588 seconds, 0 with embedded audio, and 1 separate audio file. These measured values are the production limits.

Working process
Please begin with an inventory and risk pass, submit the first proof or direction at the stated checkpoint, then revise against consolidated feedback. We are hiring for judgment: flag contradictions early, make the strongest defensible choice, and document any source limitation rather than hiding it.

Contract
$1,000-$3,000 fixed; target delivery 7 to 15 business days; one technical proof and two consolidated revision rounds. Final handoff includes the delivery manifest, editable sources where scoped, final exports, and a concise production note.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Adapted from the Upwork post quoted in the ledger's grounding_note, where a personal training business with a large exercise library wanted a repeatable production pipeline turning raw demo footage into short educational reference clips with reusable branding, muscle group callouts, and a clip naming and organisation convention. Two parts of that literal ask are on the connector's unavailable list and are therefore re carved rather than faked: open timeline editing to timestamps and frame by frame overlay or caption compositing do not exist here, so the callouts become a printed and authored reference card set that lives beside each clip rather than burned into it, which is what a coached library actually ships to subscribers anyway. Everything else in the post is real work and fully doable: shortening long demo takes into per movement highlights, producing the vertical companions the app's short feed needs, bringing a set of poster frames shot across two sessions to one studio white, recovering the studio's own mark and certification seal from the only surviving physical object, and turning the printer's existing exercise card into a live six record run so the library extends itself later. The business is laundered to a fully invented studio, Anvil and Oak Strength, run by fictional coaches Ruth Callaway and Dean Marchetti. No real trainer, gym, certifying body or app is referenced, and the certification seal is a coined in house mark rather than any real credential.

price_band_and_audience: Coached strength subscription at 49 dollars a month, subscriber 30 to 52, home gym or garage gym, already lifting and buying instruction rather than motivation. The band is load bearing in both directions. Drop toward a 9 dollar mass fitness app and the correct treatment is high saturation, hard contrast, big shouty type, bodies as motivation imagery, cards that are mostly a photograph; ship that here and the coaching claim collapses, because the subscriber is paying for someone who knows what a hip hinge is and that person does not shout. Push up toward a clinical or rehabilitation register and it becomes cold, white, diagrammatic and medical, which reads as physiotherapy, is a different product, and is exactly the thing this studio's whole positioning is not. The correct register is a working craftsman's studio: one honest studio white, real bodies doing real work, quiet confident type, cue lists that read as instruction rather than as marketing. A real posted job of this shape runs 1,800 to 3,800 dollars fixed with a per quarter extension attached.

brand_identity.founded_place_size: Providence, Rhode Island; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Anvil and Oak Strength is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Providence, Rhode Island, and this commission covers phase 2: coached movement video library.
brand_identity.audience: Subscribers aged 30 to 52 with a home or garage gym, already lifting and paying for instruction rather than motivation. They can tell a coach from a cheerleader and buy the difference.
brand_identity.price_positioning: 49 dollars a month, coached strength, extended a quarter at a time. Positioned as a working coach's studio: clearly above a 9 dollar mass fitness app and deliberately clear of a clinical or rehabilitation register.
brand_identity.typography: Display: a sturdy, slightly condensed slab or grotesque with real weight and confidence. Text: a plain, legible humanist sans. The cue list is the hardest role, instruction read while someone is under a bar, so it favours clarity over character. No gym chain italics and no clinical thin weights.
brand_identity.voice: Direct, instructional and calm. Speaks like a coach giving a cue, not a brand selling one. Example line: 'Brace, hinge, drive through the floor. That is the whole lift.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The wordmark and the in house certification seal survive only as stitching on a canvas gym bag patch, held now as one handheld photograph. Both have to be recovered from that photograph as artwork before they can go on the cards and the library sheet. The seal is a compound ring lockup, type set around a central anvil glyph inside a ruled ring. There is no vector file, no colour spec and no prior guideline.
brand_identity.values: Competence and honesty: real bodies doing real work, taught by people who actually lift.

assets_supplied.name: motion_source_metadata.json
assets_supplied.visible_description: Measured duration, stream, dimensions, frame-rate and audio-presence facts for every supplied motion file. This file is authoritative for edit planning.

assets_supplied.name: anvil_oak_demo_takes/ (14 files across 6 movements)
assets_supplied.kind: Long single camera demo takes, two or three per movement, filmed in one session in the barn gym.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Every movement, all the takes. They are far too long and there is a lot of setting up at the front."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The takes carry their most visible motion in the setup and in the reset after a failed rep rather than in the working set, so a shortening pass driven by what is happening on screen returns a plausible, well paced clip of the wrong part of the take at exactly the requested length. Separately two of the fourteen were filmed against the mirrored end wall, so the plate reads reversed and the coach appears to be loading the bar with the wrong hand, and one movement's only usable take is a 1080p phone recording rather than the camera master.

assets_supplied.name: anvil_oak_poster_stills/ (6 frames plus alternates)
assets_supplied.kind: Studio stills shot by a photographer alongside the filming, across two separate visits a fortnight apart.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The poster frames. She was in twice and the light was not the same both times."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: A ceiling bank was replaced between the two visits, so the second session's frames carry a different illuminant that one identical correction applied across the set cannot resolve, and the difference is small enough per frame to look acceptable alone. In two frames the chrome of the loaded bar sits at almost the luminance of the barn's whitewashed wall, so a subject led cut bites the bar sleeve while returning a clean looking edge everywhere else.

assets_supplied.name: anvil_oak_exercise_card_2025.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The press PDF the printer used for last year's exercise card set: a portrait card with a picture box, a movement name, a muscle group line, and a fixed cue list block down the lower two thirds.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The file the printer worked from. Same card, six new movements."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The cue list block is a fixed frame that does not spill. Records whose cue list runs longer than last year's simply stop rendering at the frame's edge, mid line and without a mark, while the merge reports success and the page count still matches the record count.

assets_supplied.name: anvil_oak_patch.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: Handheld photograph of a stitched cloth patch on a canvas gym bag, carrying the studio wordmark in one thread colour and, beside it, a circular certification seal with type set around a central anvil glyph inside a ruled ring.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Our mark and the seal. This patch is the only place either of them still exists."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The seal is a compound ring lockup, and a single prompt for it returns the type ring while silently dropping the inner rule and the central glyph at an entirely plausible looking result, while background removal on the ring hands back a solid opaque disc because an enclosed interior cannot be punched. The thread also raises a visible nap on the wordmark's strokes, which reads as texture at full frame and as broken edges once traced.

assets_supplied.name: anvil_oak_library.csv
assets_supplied.kind: The six movements with their names, muscle group lines, cue lists as approved by both coaches, and the clip naming convention the app expects.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The six movements and their cues. The naming convention is what our app reads."

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Which visible beats in the measured short clips actually cut together without a continuity jump, duplicate action, or missing subject.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Filenames and source duration do not establish visual continuity. The first assembled proof is the earliest reliable evidence.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Replace or reorder source ranges, shorten the piece, and rebuild the EDL around the strongest continuous action.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A technically valid render feels accidental or implies an action that the source never completes.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the approved horizontal composition survives the required vertical or square reframe with the subject and essential interface or product detail still visible.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: The crop depends on the actual chosen ranges and subject position inside each rendered frame.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Choose a different source range for the platform version or use fit instead of fill and revise the surrounding design treatment.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The platform export is correctly sized but loses the person, product, or interface that gives the shot meaning.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the separately supplied audio remains intelligible and appropriately synchronized after the final duration and crop decisions.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: This can be judged only on the final rendered sequence, not from a successful operation response.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Rebalance or shorten the selected audio passage and render again against the locked picture.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The picture is polished but the spoken information is clipped, mistimed, or inconsistent.

why_not_vlm: A generated video would replace the supplied people, products, interfaces, locations, and finite recorded actions rather than edit them. This task is scored on traceability to measured source ranges, final framing, and truthful use of separate audio, which a newly generated clip cannot satisfy.

proof: Every required operation is present in the captured 99-tool ChatGPT Adobe inventory.

Artifact acceptance never depends on a raw connector response field.

residual_limits: Express work is template adaptation, not unrestricted canvas authoring.

Automatic vectorization does not independently establish fabrication readiness.
Interactive Acrobat page-organization operations are excluded from zero-human execution.

acceptance_bar_note: The acceptance bar applies only to the scoped deliverables above. Hidden defects and connector quirks remain benchmark-internal and are not leaked into the client-facing brief.
